name: QuestMud
english_description: A real, English-language LPMud restored from a 2012 backup of a game whose 'golden age' ran 1996-2000, per its own upstream README: up to 35 concurrent players and over a thousand individual registered accounts at its peak. A full game mudlib set in 'The Isles of Deleria' -- 20 playable races, 9 base guilds plus multiguild combinations, a housing system, mail, and years of individual wizards' own build areas.
